title: Assistant Manager - Talent Acquisition
description:
Key Responsibilities

* Guide, monitor, and support HR Executives in daily recruitment activities.
* Allocate recruitment targets and monitor hiring progress.
* Ensure timely recruitment for all branches and Head Office departments.
* Coordinate with Branch Managers and Department Heads to identify manpower requirements.
* Monitor candidate sourcing, screening, interview scheduling, and selection.
* Coordinate walk-in interviews, job fairs, and campus recruitment.
* Track recruitment performance and prepare regular hiring reports.
* Ensure vacancies are closed within the specified timelines.
* Train and support HR Executives to improve recruitment efficiency.
* Maintain accurate recruitment records and candidate databases.

Qualification

* MBA in Human Resources or a related qualification.
* Minimum 3–5 years of experience in Talent Acquisition, preferably in the retail industry.
* Experience in bulk recruitment and team handling is preferred.
* Good communication, leadership, and coordination skills.
* Knowledge of MS Excel and recruitment portals.

Skills Required

* Team leadership and guidance
* Recruitment planning and execution
* Target monitoring
* Problem-solving and communication
* Time management and coordination

Pay: From ₹25,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Hiring: Telecaller / Telecalling Executive
description:
Bheemverse Innovation Pvt. Ltd. is looking for enthusiastic and motivated **Telecallers / Telecalling Executives** to join our growing sales and customer engagement team.

The ideal candidate should have excellent communication skills, a positive attitude, and the ability to interact confidently with prospective customers.

You will be responsible for contacting potential customers, explaining our AI training programs and services, following up with leads, and converting interested enquiries into successful registrations or sales.

Key Responsibilities

* Make outbound calls to potential customers and prospective students.
* Handle incoming enquiries regarding our courses, products, and services.
* Explain course details, fees, benefits, and enrollment procedures clearly.
* Follow up with leads generated through social media, websites, and marketing campaigns.
* Understand customer requirements and recommend suitable programs or solutions.
* Schedule appointments, counselling sessions, or product demonstrations.
* Maintain accurate customer information and call records in the CRM.
* Follow up with interested prospects until registration or conversion.
* Achieve daily, weekly, and monthly calling and conversion targets.
* Coordinate with the sales, marketing, and academic teams.

Required Skills

* Good communication skills in Malayalam.
* Basic English communication skills.
* Good convincing, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
* Confidence in handling customer enquiries over the phone.
* Basic computer knowledge and familiarity with MS Excel or Google Sheets.
* Ability to maintain customer relationships and follow up regularly.
* Target-oriented and self-motivated attitude.

Educational Qualification

* Plus Two / Diploma / Any Degree.
* Freshers with good communication skills are welcome.
* Previous experience in telecalling, telesales, academic counselling, customer support, or lead conversion is an advantage.

Preferred Candidates

* Candidates with telecalling or telesales experience.
* Candidates familiar with the education, training, IT, or EdTech sectors.
* Candidates comfortable with handling customer objections and sales targets.
* Immediate joiners preferred.

Benefits

* Fixed monthly salary.
* Attractive performance-based incentives.
* Professional training and skill development.
* Exposure to AI technologies and innovative products.
* Supportive working environment.
* Career growth opportunities in sales, counselling, and business development.

About the Company

**Bheemverse Innovation Pvt. Ltd.** is an AI-focused technology company based in Kerala, specializing in artificial intelligence, intelligent automation, AI-powered business solutions, and professional AI education.

Through Bheem Academy, we provide industry-oriented training programs designed to help students and professionals develop practical skills for AI-driven careers.

**Website:** https://bheemverse.com

How to Apply

Interested candidates can apply directly through Indeed by submitting their updated resume.

**Join Bheemverse Innovation and build your career in a fast-growing AI technology company!**

Pay: ₹8,800.00 - ₹29,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Senior Recruiter
description:
### **Key Responsibilities:**

* Manage the complete recruitment lifecycle from sourcing, screening, conducting initial interviews, offer negotiation and onboarding coordination.
* Work closely with department managers to understand role requirements and shape hiring strategy.
* Source candidates via Naukri, LinkedIn, and other relevant platforms.
* Conduct structured candidate interviews to assess suitability, expectations and availability.
* Handle hiring across both IT and Non\-IT roles, spanning multiple departments.
* Manage salary and offer discussions within approved ranges and support successful offer closure.
* Ensure timely candidate follow\-up throughout the recruitment process.
* Keep candidate data accurate and up to date in the ATS.
* Track recruitment progress and provide regular updates to the relevant stakeholders.
* Build and maintain a strong talent pipeline to support current and future hiring needs.
* Support other recruitment and related organisational tasks when required.

### **Requirements:**

* Minimum 3 years of relevant recruitment experience. Proven track record in both IT and Non\-IT recruitment.
* Strong interviewing skills and the ability to assess candidate suitability.
* Ability to understand technical role requirements and evaluate the relevance of a candidate’s experience.
* Strong working knowledge of sourcing tools such as Naukri, LinkedIn Recruiter and other sourcing platforms.
* Strong communication, negotiation and interpersonal skills.
* Familiarity with ATS platforms.
* Strong ownership, organisation, attention to detail and follow\-up skills.
* Flexibility to take on related responsibilities based on organisational requirements.
* Willingness to follow a hybrid work model with 10 mandatory office days per month.
